dedupe_keys.name: ddre 33 wind and pv scenarios on ieee 33 bus network

description: The DDRE-33 team publishes distributed wind and photovoltaic generation scenarios for the IEEE 33-bus distribution benchmark. The Figshare deposit lists one-day and one-week scenario archives, actual-labelled companions and node-specific PV and wind CSV files. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. The resource can stress-test distribution-grid flow, scheduling and renewable integration algorithms, with model-pypsa a related but differently structured power-system model. Coverage is a synthetic test network, not observed utility feeders. A caveat is that the term actual in filenames should not be interpreted as real grid measurement without reading the included documentation. Scenario generation assumptions, spatial correlation and time resolution require inspection before comparative model evaluation. The own metadata and file manifest were read; archives and CSV rows were not downloaded. The code that generates the scenarios is a separate public repository.
